LESSON: RELIGIOUS CEREMONIES • NAAM • VIVAH • ANTIM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Sanskaars (Jains)
Topic 6.1: Religious Ceremonies • Naam • Vivah • Antim
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 13

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Religious Ceremonies • Naam • Vivah • Antim, part of Sanskaars (Jains) in Grade 8 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How do religious ceremonies influence one’s life? 2. What role does religious ceremonies play in society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. use digital devices/resource persons/publications to research in groups on the religious ceremonies to create a PowerPoint presentation for discussion,

2. imagine and create a story that incorporates any one of the religious ceremonies,

3. visit a Derasar to observe Sanskaars being performed and take notes,

4. collect items/accessories needed to participate in Jain Sanskaars,

5. invite a resource person to learn about the necessary protocols observed during the mentioned ceremonies,

6. tabulate/write a list of activities that are performed during religious ceremonies, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. use digital devices/resource persons/publications to research in groups on the religious ceremonies to create a PowerPoint presentation for discussion,
2. imagine and create a story that incorporates any one of the religious ceremonies,
3. visit a Derasar to observe Sanskaars being performed and take notes,
4. collect items/accessories needed to participate in Jain Sanskaars,
5. invite a resource person to learn about the necessary protocols observed during the mentioned ceremonies,
6. tabulate/write a list of activities that are performed during religious ceremonies, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Religious Ceremonies • Naam • Vivah • Antim together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: The learner enhances self-awareness and planning skills while using digital devices with assistive technology

to research, in groups on the religious ceremonies to create a PowerPoint presentation/ tactual illustration.

● Digital literacy: The learner interacts with digital technology by using digital devices to research in groups.

Values:
Responsibility: The learner enhances self-drive when tabulating/writing a list of activities that are performed during religious

ceremonies.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCI’s):

Life skills: The learner develops social awareness skills (empathy, assertiveness, friendship formation, peer pressure resistance,

conflict resolution and effective communication) while imagining and creating a story that incorporates at least one of the three

jewels through self-evaluation.

Link to other subjects:

• The learner can relate to the skills of using digital devices to create a PowerPoint presentation/tactual illustration for

discussion, to the skills learnt in Pre-Technical Studies.

the skills of tabulating/writing learnt in Mathematics.
